title: Trees knocked flat to the northeast

tellings.quote: and Bill said, "You know, if they drag that thing up to the dragon wagon, they use [music] soft trees to do it over. These aren't going to hurt anything." And he said, "Notice they're all spled to the northeast."

plain: At Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, where a flying saucer is said to have crashed in 1948, trees at the site are said to be bent over all in one direction, to the northeast, as if something had been dragged across them. Scott Ramsey, a researcher who has walked the site, repeats what the investigator Bill Steinman pointed out to him: that the craft was hauled over soft trees to a dragon wagon, a heavy military hauling truck, and "notice they're all splayed to the northeast." If true, the trees would be physical traces of the recovery.
